title: Stay, Reposition, or Recharge: Battery-Aware Operation of Robotaxi Fleets
abstract: arXiv:2611.07699v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Electric robotaxis are rapidly expanding from pilots to scaled commercial deployment; unlike traditional human-driven ride-hailing vehicles, they require centralized fleet control and careful management of vehicle state of charge (SoC). We study how a fleet manager should jointly make service, empty repositioning, idling, and charging decisions in such systems. We develop a continuous-time fluid model in which vehicles evolve across location-charge states, and identify two forms of charge-aware control that are absent from classic repositioning models: early return-to-depot (RTD) and charge-aware repositioning. In particular, the optimal solution admits simple threshold structures. Each location has a battery threshold such that vehicles should return to the depot to recharge when their SoC is below it and should not do so when their SoC is above it. translated_title: 停留、重新调度还是充电：自动驾驶出租车车队的电池感知运营
translated_abstract: 电动自动驾驶出租车正从试点阶段快速扩展至规模化商业部署；与传统由人类驾驶的网约车不同，它们需要集中的车队控制以及对车辆荷电状态（SoC）的精细管理。我们研究了车队管理者应如何在此类系统中联合做出服务、空车重新调度、闲置和充电决策。我们建立了一个连续时间流体模型，其中车辆在“位置-电量”状态之间演化，并识别出经典重新调度模型中所缺失的两种电量感知控制形式：提前返回场站（RTD）和电量感知的重新调度。特别地，最优解呈现出简单的阈值结构。每个位置都存在一个电池阈值：当车辆的SoC低于该阈值时，应返回场站充电；高于该阈值时则不应返回。车辆同样不应在低于同一阈值时进行重新调度；高于该阈值时，其选择……
tldr: 本文提出一个连续时间流体模型来研究自动驾驶出租车车队的服务、重新调度与充电联合决策，证明了最优策略具有简单的阈值结构，并识别出经典重新调度模型所缺失的“提前返回场站充电”与“电量感知重新调度”两种控制机制。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a continuous-time fluid model for jointly optimizing service, repositioning, idling, and charging decisions in robotaxi fleets, showing that the optimal policy has a simple threshold structure and identifying two charge-aware control mechanisms absent from classic repositioning models: early return-to-depot and charge-aware repositioning.
